# Rework round 5 claims (personal_loan_servicing)

PLS-R4-1: closed — return rows carry no payment type, so the ledger cannot tell which returns undid an installment. Each of the four counts is therefore now stated exactly as it is computed: scheduled_installment payments posted, less one for every payment returned whatever it was for. A returned payment of any kind is a mark on the payment record. "Credited" is gone from the rules, ladders, compute_basis quotes and task-1 traces. Members: refinance payment-record credit, late-fee first-late share, returned-fee first-return share, courtesy installment-record point.
PLS-R4-1 class (AutoPay debit counts): closed — the four AutoPay counts (refinance AutoPay credit, late-fee AutoPay share, returned-fee AutoPay share, AutoPay debit-record step) now say "AutoPay debits". Each rule defines an AutoPay debit as any payment AutoPay took, a hardship plan payment included, and an AutoPay debit returned as a return of such a payment. That is exactly what compute counts; the earlier "installment debits" wording had a second reading.
PLS-R4-2: closed — the pay-cycle form and the bank-event form now read the latest FlexLine late fee and the latest FlexLine returned-payment fee net of every FlexLine fee waiver applied to them (summed by the waiver's link to that fee). In rule and compute: one waived in full counts as no FlexLine fee, so the schedule figure or amount applies; one waived in part counts at its unwaived amount, in the tier-2 offsets too. The tier-1 premise now reads "left as it stands", and the ladders, compute_basis quotes and task-1 traces were updated.
PLS-R4-2 class (reversed rows, courtesy waiver): closed — the waived fee's unpaid part no longer counts a fee payment line that was later reversed. A late fee paid through two or more fee payment lines is outside this policy's courtesy amount, which then works out to 0.00 and, under the zero rule, is not granted. The rule, the policy baseline sentence and compute agree.
Whole-charter read-site sweep: closed — every count and latest-record read in the six policies is listed in the worklog with its rule wording and compute filter, and each was probed on a scratch copy with the matching decoy (returned, waived, reversed, other kind, other status, other purpose). Every probe agrees with the rule. A FlexLine or PracticePay fee waived later still counts as a fee charged, because those rules count charges.
R4-O1, R3-O1, R2-O3, R2-O4: carried — unchanged.
